name: @repo/ai-reasoning
description: Collapsible AI reasoning trace that shimmers only while the model works, reports how long it took and gets out of the way.

useCases: Agent step log that should not dominate the layout
Any disclosure that becomes clutter once resolved
compositionHints: Pass isStreaming so the shimmer means work, not decoration
Leave collapseWhenDone on unless the trace is the main content
A manual open or close stops the component deciding for the user
